Kolomoni Business Banking API — Test Suite Results

Results of running the generated test suite (Happy, Negative and Edge cases for every endpoint) against the development API. Findings are ranked by severity: server errors first, then security, happy-path failures, the coverage gap, per-area results and lower-priority mismatches. Every table lists the actual endpoints and status codes.

Fix first

104 server errors on 27 endpoints

The Audit service answers 503 on every call. SSA onboarding, closing balances, terminal stock, admin schedules and bank-net reports return 500.

Security

Replays accepted, open endpoints

7 encrypted POSTs accept a replayed nonce, including login. 11 requests succeeded with no credentials, including POST /api/v1/agents/new (201).

Coverage

67.3% of requests could not test anything

Only 9 of 1,304 token-authenticated Happy requests succeeded, 8 of them on the auth service. Every other service rejected the token with 401.

Read the pass rate with care. 2,200 of the 2,467 passes are tests that expected a 401 (missing or invalid token, wrong PIN or OTP) and got one. They show that authentication rejects bad credentials, but most of them never reached the endpoint's own logic. Only 267 passes exercised API behaviour, and only 27 endpoints have a confirmed working Happy path.

Coverage gap: what could not be tested

5,878 requests · 1,351 endpoints
5,523

Access token rejected (401)

Requests sent with the run's bearer token. Outside /api/v2/auth almost every service answered 401.

342

API key missing (401)

Partner and onboarding endpoints need X-API-KEY. The run's environment had no api_key value.

5

Forbidden (403)

Reverification endpoints refused this account.

8

No response

Connection resets and socket timeouts on agent, savings and back-office routes.

Why the token was rejected. The likely cause is an unfinished login, not the account's role:
  • The token is valid in time (issued 14:43, expires 24 hours later), so expiry is ruled out.
  • Role-restricted endpoints should answer 403. All 42 "Role not authorised" tests got 401 instead.
  • The token's claims show authentication_type: TOTP with the TOTP flag unset. The run logged in with /authenticate, but /finalize-login (the OTP step) returned 400. The API docs say a token is accepted elsewhere only after that step completes.
Re-run after completing /setup-mfa and /finalize-login with a live OTP, and set api_key. Use extra accounts in other roles to verify role-based access.

Not run at all

Stateful, file-upload and IP-restriction tests were switched off for this run, so none of them ran.

Role-based access is unverified: every role test hit the 401 above.

Detail, update and delete routes used placeholder ids, because list requests never returned records to capture.

74 write endpoints have no documented request body, so only their auth, method and path were tested.

Endpoints never reached: 1,275 blocked by the token, 74 by the missing API key, 1 by 403 and 1 with no response. Filter the table below by Could not test to list them.

Lower priority and test strictness

211 requests

The API rejected or handled these requests safely, but not in the way the test expected. Most need a test tweak or a contract clean-up, not a code fix. Pagination and error-field mismatches are worth a look.

69

422 returned where 400/401/403 expected

Encryption edge tests: the API rejects with 422. A valid rejection; relax the test or standardise the code.

26

Error names a different field

The error message points at a different field than the one omitted, e.g. user_id instead of identity_type.

22

Pagination not enforced

page=0, non-integer pages and page_size=1 are ignored and return the full list.

22

Other status mismatch

A rejection came back with a different 4xx code than the test expected.

20

Rate-limited (429)

Repeat calls to password and OTP flows were throttled during the run.

17

Error body not in documented shape

The 4xx body is not detail, message or field errors as documented.

16

404 where another code expected

404 returned where 400 or 405 was expected.

12

Negative or edge case accepted (2xx)

An edge or negative input was accepted with 2xx.

6

Encryption test not applicable (GET has no body)

Encryption tests on GET endpoints carry no body, so a 200 proves nothing. Drop these tests.

Wrong code for unsupported method

All requests

8,735 rows

Every request in the run. Filter by outcome or area, or search by path, endpoint name or test.

OutcomeAreaMethodEndpoint · testGotmsReason / detail

How requests were classified. Each request was put in one bucket, in this order: server error (any 5xx); security (2xx with no credentials, a replayed or tampered encrypted POST accepted, injected markup echoed back, or an invalid phone or email accepted); could not test (401 with a credential the API should accept, 403, or no response); passed; happy-path failure; lower priority (any other failed assertion). Encryption tests on GET endpoints were moved to lower priority, because a GET carries no body.

Recommended order

  1. Restore the Audit service and fix the 500s in SSA onboarding, balances, terminal stock, admin schedules and bank-net reports.
  2. Enforce single-use nonces on encrypted POSTs, and require authentication on /api/v1/agents/new, the engagement-content routes and the two API-key endpoints that answered without a key.
  3. Finish the MFA login (finalize-login) for the test account, set api_key, add role-specific accounts and seed record ids, then re-run to close the 67.3% gap.
  4. Decide on 422 versus 400/401/403 for encryption rejections, fix pagination, and align error bodies with the documented shape.

Source: newman results report-01…22.json in kolo-test-run, re-classified for this report.
